scope: Two unit-owned one-aircraft fixed missions of different types: per-unit and per-type native rows add to the all-unit result. A group membership selector has no child mission rows; an A17 group-owned mission has a group row and no member-unit mission rows. One seed, one 36-hour horizon, report-only local settings.
limitations: Group membership alone did not produce an aggregate of member-unit missions; do not claim it does.
Regenerative denominator, mid-mission partial outcomes, GUI rendering, and cross-engine parity are unverified.
